title: synthyris lanuginosa
intro: Synthyris lanuginosa, commonly known as hairy bog-bean or woolly synthyris, is a flowering plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Synthyris lanuginosa include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and vulnerary agent, making it useful for wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented, but it is believed to contain alkaloids and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
